# AgentContextKit

> AgentContextKit (ACKit) 0.2.2 is an offline-first deterministic toolkit for turning repositories into agent-ready working environments.

Use the documentation for exact CLI behavior, readiness, instruction resolution, security and integrations. Canonical product source is the GitHub repository.

## Documentation

- [AgentContextKit](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/): Offline-first deterministic toolkit for agent-ready repositories.
- [Getting Started](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/getting-started/): Install and initialize AgentContextKit.
- [CLI Reference](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/cli/): ACKit commands, options and exit behavior.
- [Readiness](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/readiness/): Explainable repository readiness scoring.
- [Optimize](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/optimize/): Instruction and context hygiene advisor.
- [Provider Profiles](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/profiles/): Provider-aware context profiles.
- [Instruction Graph](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/instruction-graph/): Resolve nested agent instructions with provenance and precedence.
- [Rule Packs](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/rule-packs/): Declarative offline repository policy checks.
- [GitHub Action](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/github-action/): Run ACKit checks in GitHub Actions.
- [MCP](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/mcp/): Local Model Context Protocol integration.
- [SDK](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/sdk/): Programmatic repository analysis.
- [Dashboard](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/dashboard/): Local dashboard and repository views.
- [Diagnostics](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/diagnostics/): Environment and support diagnostics.
- [VS Code](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/vscode/): AgentContextKit VS Code integration.
- [Security](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/security/): Offline-first threat model and redaction guarantees.
- [Benchmarks](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/benchmarks/): Deterministic performance benchmarks.
- [Migration](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/migration/): Upgrade to the current release.

## Source and package

- [GitHub](https://github.com/Cynrath/agent-context-kit): canonical source, issues, releases and discussions.
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cynrath/agent-context-kit): package @cynrath/agent-context-kit.
- [Cynrath](https://cynrath.github.io/): developer site and project overview.
